name: StatusLight 状态灯
description: DeepSeek Harness 静态插件：角色表情状态灯 + 聊天框气泡 + Windows 系统级置顶小窗。Reflects model state via character expressions, with chat bubbles and an always-on-top mini window.
author: kongchengavg

requirements.mechanism: static dsh plugin bundle (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-statuslight)
